title: Fork memoir into Varys
body: Varys was forked from memoir as an independent product. The package, credential service, database, lock file, and configuration prefix were renamed so Varys stores state separately. Memoir's data directory, configuration, caches, and life data were explicitly not carried over.

title: Projects-folder indexing incident
body: The documents connector used rglob and accidentally ingested 34,898 files from the projects folder, including a memoir vault, WhatsApp stores, browser-profile data, caches, dependencies, and generated trees. Gitignore-aware pruning and fail-closed deny lists reduced the set by 97 percent.

title: AdAstra pre-run spending gate
body: AdAstra runs a pre-run gate as step 0 before scanning, writing, rendering, or spending. It checks the kill switch, workspace, database, disk, project grounding, renderers, and live provider probes. It stops at the first failure and the mid-run halt stops generation when a reviewer stops answering.

title: Semantic extractor prompt v8
body: Varys changed semantic-facets-v7 to v8 to remove real WhatsApp sentences from two few-shot examples before publishing the repository. Synthetic examples preserve the intended extraction lessons while de-identifying the owner's archive for privacy.

title: Idempotent Varys ingestion
body: Each Varys entry has the natural key source, source account, and external ID. Normalized content is upserted rather than appended, and the connector cursor is persisted in the same transaction as the entry. A crash or repeated sync therefore neither duplicates nor loses an item.
